title: Exact DXF modeler-carrier contract, directional peer claims, and lower-cost qualification gates
mode: Read-only primary-source research and plan update
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Verify DXF 3DSOLID group-code and history-reference distinctions against Autodesk's entity references.
Refresh current ACadSharp direction/version declarations and issue-specific reader/writer failure shapes.
Reconcile LibreDWG release-note claims with exact DWG output-version behavior.
Check ezdxf transfer documentation and FreeCAD's DWG converter/DXF importer and ACIS consumer boundaries.
Refine implementation sequencing and evidence gates without adding fixtures, dependencies, or per-slice validation cost.

sources.name: Autodesk 3DSOLID DXF reference
sources.evidence: 3DSOLID has AcDbModelerGeometry, modeler version code 70, proprietary group 1 data with optional group 3 continuations, AcDb3dSolid, and group 350 soft-owner history reference.

sources.name: Autodesk common entity DXF codes
sources.evidence: Common entity code 92 plus repeated 310 records represent proxy graphics; the documentation warns against relying on the presented common-code order.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification 5.4.1
sources.evidence: R2007 introduces the AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b data-storage section used for ACIS payloads, distinct from inline DXF entity-carrier groups.

sources.name: ACadSharp repository matrix and issues #1299, #1253, #1261
sources.evidence: README declares direction-specific format versions. Current issue reports cover DWG-to-DXF spline output, strict AutoCAD DXF rejection, and versioned GeoData DWG read/write omissions. Reports are not independently reproduced here.

sources.name: LibreDWG NEWS
sources.evidence: NEWS describes R2004/AC1018 writer support and states that R2007 output falls back to R2010 rather than direct R2007 encoding.

sources.name: ezdxf xref documentation
sources.evidence: The transfer feature documents a restricted set of copyable/transformable DXF entities and related resources; entity class presence alone does not establish general transfer or semantic support.

sources.name: FreeCAD Draft DXF and import/export preferences
sources.evidence: FreeCAD has distinct C++ and legacy Python DXF importer routes; DWG uses an external converter followed by the selected DXF importer; stock DXF import cannot read embedded ACIS solids.

method.limitations: Mutable peer documentation and issue bodies establish declarations and reported failure shapes, not runtime behavior of current artifacts or a libdxfrw defect. ACIS carrier checks do not establish valid B-rep semantics.

localCrosswalk.3DSOLID: Existing PAR-07/S8 owner: distinguish group 1/3 modeler payload, group 70 version, group 350 soft-owner history link, and proxy-only 92/310 data; add runtime-generated carrier/continuation/sentinel/reference controls when that owner is implemented.
localCrosswalk.AcDs: Keep R2007+ DWG storage/key/owner/payload closure separate from inline DXF 3DSOLID groups and preserve the ODA-spec-first rule for binary changes.

ACadSharp.1299: Existing SPLINE DWG decode to neutral model to DXF writer route; peer issue is a failure shape, not a new local finding.
ACadSharp.1253: Existing group type/order and strict independent DXF writer acceptance route.
ACadSharp.1261: Existing GeoData versioned read/write tail and field-symmetry checks.

localCrosswalk.LibreDWG: Record input/output version and direction precisely; an R2010 fallback cannot count as direct R2007 writer support.
localCrosswalk.FreeCAD: Keep native Linux/Windows qualification composed and backend-specific; stock ACIS import is outside its documented consumer capability.
localCrosswalk.externalEvidence: J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 stay DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
